correctness.rationale: Directional Crofton flux is sum_i |u_i|, and the entry-face probability of opposite exit at i is product_{j≠i}(1−|u_j|/|u_i|)_+. Replacing homogeneous spherical ratio with Gaussian expectations and size-biasing |G_i| gives Rayleigh density x e^{−x²/2}, and integrates the independent Gaussian coordinates to F(x)=erf(x/√2)−μ(1−e^{−x²/2})/x. d=2 flux integral yields √2−1. The asymptotic −log F=μ/x+μ²/(2x²)+μ³/(3x³)+O(x^-4), q=(μ(d−1))^{1/3}, and centered x=q+s lead to action 3q²/2+μ q/2+μ²/3+3s²/2−μs. Uniform tails permit Gaussian Laplace normalization, producing √(2π/3)q exp(−3q²/2−μ q/2−μ²/6) and s⇒N(μ/3,1/3). Under Crofton-direction weighting, radial flux gives a χ_{d+1} radial law independent of direction; R/√d→1 and R−√d=O_P(1), while X=q+O_P(1), so L=R/X yields d^{1/6}(L−√d/q)⇒−μ^{-2/3}Z. Independent numerical integration confirmed p2 and saddle probability ratio convergence through d=5000; finite calculations are not asymptotic proofs.
